name: exp_trendmagic
summary: This EA implements the Trend Magic strategy, which combines the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) with Average True Range (ATR) to generate a trailing stop line that changes color based on trend direction. It opens buy positions when the Trend Magic line turns bullish and sell positions when it turns bearish, using the indicator line as both entry signal and dynamic stop loss. The strategy aims to capture sustained trends while providing clear exit signals through trend reversal detection.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Trend Magic策略，结合CCI（商品通道指数）和ATR（平均真实范围）生成一条根据趋势方向变色的追踪止损线。当Trend Magic线转为看涨时开多仓，转为看跌时开空仓，同时将该指标线作为入场信号和动态止损。该策略旨在捕捉持续趋势，并通过趋势反转检测提供明确的出场信号。
strategy_analysis: Trend Magic策略的核心概念是将CCI指标与ATR结合，构建一条动态的趋势判断线和止损线。具体而言，首先计算ATR值并乘以一个系数作为偏移量，然后基于CCIchange指标判断当前趋势方向：当CCI高于阈值时为上升趋势，Trend Magic线取前期低点减去ATR偏移量；当CCI低于阈值时为下降趋势，Trend Magic线取前期高点加上ATR偏移量。入场条件为Trend Magic线颜色发生翻转：从下降趋势线翻转为上升趋势线时做多，反之做空。出场条件同样依赖Trend Magic线的翻转信号，即持仓方向与新的趋势方向不一致时平仓，同时该线也作为动态止损位。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设定固定手数进行交易，但未实现动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的下单逻辑。资金管理方面存在不足，缺少硬性止损设置、最大持仓限制以及回撤控制机制，完全依赖指标信号的翻转来执行出场，在极端行情下可能面临较大风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The Trend Magic strategy core concept combines the CCI indicator with ATR to construct a dynamic trend judgment and stop-loss line. Specifically, it calculates the ATR value multiplied by a coefficient as an offset, then uses the CCI indicator to determine the current trend direction: when CCI is above the threshold, it's an uptrend and the Trend Magic line takes the previous low minus the ATR offset; when CCI is below the threshold, it's a downtrend and the line takes the previous high plus the ATR offset. Entry conditions are triggered when the Trend Magic line color flips: a flip from downtrend to uptrend line signals a buy, and vice versa for a sell. Exit conditions also rely on the Trend Magic line flip signal, meaning positions are closed when the holding direction conflicts with the new trend direction, and the line also serves as a dynamic stop-loss level. Position sizing allows the user to set a fixed lot size for trading, but there is no dynamic position adjustment or equity-proportional ordering logic. Money management is lacking, with no hard stop-loss setting, maximum position limits, or drawdown control mechanisms, relying entirely on the indicator signal flip for exits, which poses significant risk during extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: ATR_Multiplier
parameters.description: ATR偏移倍数，控制止损距离
parameters.description_en: ATR offset multiplier, controls stop loss distance

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，利用CCI和ATR组合有效识别趋势方向和动态止损位
指标线变色机制直观，入场和出场信号明确，减少了主观判断的干扰
ATR自适应止损距离，能够根据市场波动性自动调整止损宽度，适应不同行情环境
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic combining CCI and ATR for effective trend identification and dynamic stop-loss placement
Color-flip mechanism provides intuitive and unambiguous entry/exit signals, reducing subjective judgment interference
ATR-adaptive stop-loss distance automatically adjusts to market volatility, adapting to different market conditions
cons: 缺少硬性止损保护，完全依赖指标翻转出场，在跳空或极端行情下可能造成大幅亏损
固定手数下单缺乏资金管理逻辑，未根据账户净值或风险比例动态调整仓位
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓或频繁交易导致过度交易
cons_en: Lacks hard stop-loss protection, relying entirely on indicator flip for exits, which may cause large losses during gaps or extreme market moves
Fixed lot sizing lacks money management logic, with no dynamic position adjustment based on account equity or risk ratio
No new bar check mechanism, potentially leading to repeated entries on the same bar or over-trading from frequent signals
improvements: 增加硬性止损和止盈设置，以及追踪止损功能，在趋势反转前锁定利润
添加资金管理模块，支持基于风险比例的动态仓位计算和最大回撤限制
增加新K线检查、点差过滤和持仓检查，提高交易的稳定性和安全性
improvements_en: Add hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, plus a trailing stop feature to lock in profits before trend reversal
Add a money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on risk ratio and maximum drawdown limits
Add new bar check, spread filter, and position check to improve trading stability and safety

risk_points: 缺少硬性止损，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
没有新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
固定手数无资金管理，小账户可能过度承担风险
risk_points_en: No hard stop-loss, potentially suffering significant losses during extreme market conditions
No new bar check, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Fixed lot size without money management may cause small accounts to take excessive risk
